KNEG001.summary: The node is triggered when the player has committed to a heavy-economy, technology-heavy ground posture but fails to convert accumulated resources into a sufficient army, leading to defeat. Avoid over-investing in technology and economy without corresponding production capacity. Do not neglect army composition and unit production while pursuing upgrades.
KNEG001.title: Resource-to-army conversion failure in a heavy-economy ground-macro posture
KNEG001.trigger_summary: The node is triggered when the player has committed to a heavy-economy, technology-heavy ground posture but fails to convert accumulated resources into a sufficient army, leading to defeat.
